---
name: Feature Request
about: Suggest a new skill, command, or capability
title: '[FEAT] '
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''
---

## Problem

What problem are you trying to solve? Why does it matter?

> Frame the problem before the solution. "I need to do X faster" is better than
> "Add a button labeled Y".

## Current Workaround

How are you solving this today? (Manually, with another tool, with an existing UpUp command?)

## Proposed Solution

A clear description of what you want to happen.

## Alternatives Considered

What other approaches did you consider? Why is this one better?

## Examples

Walk us through a concrete example of how a user would invoke this:

```
/my-new-command arg1 arg2
> (description of expected output)
```

## Priority

- [ ] Nice to have
- [ ] Significant productivity gain
- [ ] Blocking my workflow

## Affected Components

Check any that apply:

- [ ] New **slash command** (`src/commands/`)
- [ ] New **skill** (`src/skills/<name>/SKILL.md`)
- [ ] New **finance tool** (`src/tools/finance/`)
- [ ] New **plugin runtime** (`src/plugins/adapters/`)
- [ ] i18n / locale
- [ ] LLM provider
- [ ] Session / permission system
- [ ] Memory system
- [ ] Documentation (`docs/`)
- [ ] Other: ___

## Implementation Sketch

If you have a rough idea of the implementation, share it. (Optional but helpful.)

## Additional Context

Mockups, screenshots, links to similar features in other tools.

---

### For maintainers

- [ ] Scoped (in / out of scope)
- [ ] Estimated effort (S / M / L / XL)
- [ ] Discussed in maintainer review
- [ ] Milestone assigned
